lines: Apnon ke sitam hum se bataye nahin jaate
couplets.en: I cannot speak of the hurt my own have caused me.

lines: Ye haadse woh hain jo sunaye nahin jaate
Kuchh kam hi taalluq hai mohabbat ka junoon se
couplets.en: Love has rather little to do with madness.

lines: Deewane to hote hain, banaye nahin jaate
couplets.en: No one can make a person mad with love.

lines: Ik umr ki koshish se bhula di hai teri yaad
couplets.en: It took a lifetime of trying to forget you.

lines: Lekin abhi tak yaad ke saaye nahin jaate
couplets.en: Still, the shadows of remembrance linger.

lines: Pyaalon mein ho zehraab ki kuchh aur ho, Fakir
couplets.en: The cups may hold poison or something else, Fakir.

lines: Ab honthon se waapas to ye laaye nahin jaate
couplets.en: Now the cups cannot be drawn back from our lips.
